about_the_game:
You wake up on a cold metal floor with no memory of who you are or how you got here. The room is unfamiliar, and silent—until the dull hum of flickering lights reminds you: this place is alive. And you're not alone.

The Elevator throws you into the heart of a terrifying, high-stakes experiment. Somewhere deep underground, a secret facility runs tests on unwilling participants. You’ve become the latest subject. But unlike the others, you have a chance—however slim—to escape.

Explore a mysterious complex full of locked doors, hidden mechanisms, and unsettling messages left by those who came before. Solve challenging puzzles that block your path forward, uncover the clues to your identity, and stay one step ahead of the presence hunting you in the dark.

But be warned: this is no simple escape room.
Every move you make could be your last.
Every noise might attract attention.

Will you uncover the truth behind your abduction and the twisted game you’ve been forced into? Or will you join the growing list of test subjects who never made it out?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: You wake up in a mysterious facility with no memory. Solve puzzles, avoid a deadly stalker, and uncover the truth behind your abduction. Escape won’t be easy—most test subjects never make it out. Welcome to The Elevator: Chapter 1. Will you survive?.
